sections.title: The Glass Cannon Glitch
sections.intent: Introduce Artie's arrival and the discovery of his broken 1 HP / Max Crit state.
sections.end_condition: Artie confirms his stats are glitched and accepts the tutorial challenge.

scenes.summary: Artie wakes up in the Tutorial Zone and realizes he has been isekai'd into a game world.
scenes.outcome: Artie discovers his character sheet shows 1 HP and a 99% Critical Hit Rate.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie materializes in a swirl of white pixels above the grassy plains.
scenes.transition_out_text: He stares at the floating blue screen in front of his face.

scenes.summary: Artie tries to interact with the environment and nearly dies from a falling leaf.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes that any physical contact might kill him instantly.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie reaches out to touch a nearby tree, but his hand trembles.
scenes.transition_out_text: He edges away from the foliage, eyes wide with terror.

scenes.summary: Artie finds a rusted dagger and tests his critical hit chance on a training dummy.
scenes.outcome: The dummy explodes from a single tap, confirming the glitch.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie picks up a discarded blade with two fingers, treating it like a bomb.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie confirms his stats are glitched and accepts the tutorial challenge.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks toward the distant boss tower with a grimace.

sections.title: Tutorial Gauntlet
sections.intent: Demonstrate the danger of the 1 HP build against minor mobs.
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the Boss Room threshold without taking damage.

scenes.summary: Artie navigates a field of aggressive Slimes using high-speed kiting.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes his Agility is also uncapped, allowing him to move faster than the mobs.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie sprints into the field, his legs moving in a blur of motion.
scenes.transition_out_text: He leaves the slimes behind, a streak of dust in his wake.

scenes.summary: Artie reaches the gates of the Boss Tower and dodges a volley of arrows from tutorial traps.
scenes.outcome: Artie masters the 'dodge-roll' mechanic to avoid environmental hazards.
scenes.transition_in_text: The tower gate looms ahead, bristling with mechanical traps.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie reaches the Boss Room threshold without taking damage.
scenes.transition_out_text: He pushes the heavy doors open, the air inside cold and silent.

sections.title: The Impossible Crit
sections.intent: The confrontation with the Tutorial Boss and the logic-defying kill.
sections.end_condition: The Tutorial Boss dies in one hit and Artie is flagged as a Red Name anomaly.

scenes.summary: Artie enters the Boss Arena and faces the Tutorial Guardian.
scenes.outcome: The Guardian prepares a massive AoE attack that Artie must evade.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks into the center of the circular room as the floor begins to glow.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Guardian raises its stone hammer, casting a long shadow over Artie.

scenes.summary: Artie uses his speed to climb the Guardian's back and deliver a single strike.
scenes.outcome: The rusted dagger connects with the Guardian's weak point, triggering a massive damage readout.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie leaps onto the creature's leg, scrambling up the mossy armor.
scenes.transition_out_text: A blinding flash of red light erupts from the point of impact.

scenes.summary: The Guardian disintegrates and the System issues a warning to Artie.
scenes.outcome: Artie is teleported out of the tutorial with a 'Red Name' status.
scenes.transition_in_text: The world dissolves into a storm of data fragments and error codes.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The Tutorial Boss dies in one hit and Artie is flagged as a Red Name anomaly.
scenes.transition_out_text: The system chime rings with a deep, ominous red tone as Artie looks at his new status.

sections.title: Oakhaven Paranoia
sections.intent: Artie navigates the first town while hiding his criminal status.
sections.end_condition: Artie identifies the 'Hit & Run' passive exploit in his skill tree.

scenes.summary: Artie tries to enter Oakhaven but must avoid the NPC guards who detect Red Names.
scenes.outcome: Artie successfully sneaks into the city through a drainage pipe.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie approaches the wooden gates of Oakhaven, keeping his head down.
scenes.transition_out_text: He crawls out of the pipe, covered in grime but safe from the guards.

scenes.summary: Artie explores the market to find a way to hide his nameplate.
scenes.outcome: Artie buys a cheap hooded cloak that provides a minor stealth bonus.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie pulls his hood low as he enters the bustling market square.
scenes.transition_out_text: He hands over his last few coins for the tattered garment.

scenes.summary: Artie sits in an alleyway and opens his skill tree for the first time.
scenes.outcome: Artie discovers the 'Hit & Run' passive which doubles damage after a successful dodge.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie retreats into the shadows, his fingers swiping through the air.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie identifies the 'Hit & Run' passive exploit in his skill tree.
scenes.transition_out_text: A slow grin spreads across his face as he reads the skill description.

sections.title: The Agility Grind
sections.intent: Artie gathers intel and basic supplies for his glass-cannon build.
sections.end_condition: Artie locates the dungeon containing the Speedster's Cloak.

scenes.summary: Artie eavesdrops on a group of high-level players in a tavern.
scenes.outcome: Artie learns about the 'Snail-Shell Catacombs' and the legendary agility gear inside.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie slips through the tavern door, blending into the background noise.
scenes.transition_out_text: He memorizes the name of the dungeon whispered by the warriors.

scenes.summary: Artie attempts to buy a map of the catacombs but is nearly recognized by a shopkeeper.
scenes.outcome: Artie steals the map and flees the shop before the guards are called.
scenes.transition_in_text: The bell above the shop door jingles, drawing the clerk's suspicious gaze.
scenes.transition_out_text: He bolts out of the shop, the map clutched tightly to his chest.

scenes.summary: Artie practices his movement speed in the city's rooftops to evade pursuit.
scenes.outcome: Artie levels up his 'Acrobatics' skill, increasing his parkour efficiency.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie grabs a wooden crate and hoists himself onto the low-hanging eaves.
scenes.transition_out_text: He leaps across the gap between buildings, light as a feather.

scenes.summary: Artie reaches the edge of the city and identifies the path to the catacombs.
scenes.outcome: Artie finds the hidden entrance to the dungeon in a nearby forest.
scenes.transition_in_text: The sun begins to set as Artie reaches the treeline outside the walls.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie locates the dungeon containing the Speedster's Cloak.
scenes.transition_out_text: He parts a curtain of vines to reveal a stone archway.

sections.title: Catacomb Entry
sections.intent: Artie commits to the high-level dungeon dive.
sections.end_condition: Artie enters the Snail-Shell Catacombs, locking the entrance behind him.

scenes.summary: Artie encounters a low-level gatekeeper mob at the entrance.
scenes.outcome: Artie uses his 'Hit & Run' passive to one-shot the gatekeeper after a perfect dodge.
scenes.transition_in_text: A skeletal sentry rattles its bones as Artie steps into the stone archway.
scenes.transition_out_text: The skeleton shatters into white dust as Artie's blade strikes true.

scenes.summary: Artie finds a mechanism to seal the door from the inside.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he can prevent players from following him if he locks the gate.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie spots a heavy iron lever mounted to the wall beside the door.
scenes.transition_out_text: He pulls the lever, listening to the heavy gears grind into place.

scenes.summary: Artie descends into the darkness of the first floor.
scenes.outcome: Artie is now committed to the dungeon and cannot turn back.
scenes.transition_in_text: The heavy stone slab slams shut, cutting off the moonlight.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie enters the Snail-Shell Catacombs, locking the entrance behind him.
scenes.transition_out_text: He lights a torch, the flame flickering in the damp draft of the catacombs.

chapters.title: The Kiting King
chapters.goal: Clear the 'Snail-Shell Catacombs' by using high-speed kiting to avoid every single point of damage.
chapters.stakes_shift: Proving that a 'zero-health' build is viable, provided he never stops moving.

bridge.from_prev: Entering the catacombs with 1 HP but maxed-out movement speed.
bridge.to_next: Looting a 'Key of the Unseen' which alerts the local Player-Run Guild to his presence.

sections.title: The Art of the Kite
sections.intent: Establish the mechanics of Artie's high-speed combat style.
sections.end_condition: Artie successfully clears the first floor elites using zero-damage kiting.

scenes.summary: Artie encounters a pack of Snail-Shell Crawlers.
scenes.outcome: Artie uses his speed to circle the mobs, keeping them in a perpetual state of turning.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's torchlight catches the glint of slime on the walls as the crawlers emerge.
scenes.transition_out_text: He begins to run in a tight circle, his feet barely touching the ground.

scenes.summary: Artie tests the limits of his stamina while kiting the pack.
scenes.outcome: Artie discovers that his Agility also reduces stamina consumption for sprinting.
scenes.transition_in_text: His breath is steady despite the frantic pace he sets.
scenes.transition_out_text: He picks up speed, the crawlers falling further and further behind.

scenes.summary: Artie eliminates the crawlers one by one with precision strikes.
scenes.outcome: Artie confirms that his 'Hit & Run' bonus stacks with his base Crit chance.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie pivots on one heel and lunges at the nearest crawler.
scenes.transition_out_text: The last crawler collapses into a heap of dissolving data.

scenes.summary: Artie faces the Elite Sentry of the first floor.
scenes.outcome: Artie defeats the sentry without taking a single hit, perfecting his kiting rhythm.
scenes.transition_in_text: A larger, armored figure blocks the passage to the next level.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie successfully clears the first floor elites using zero-damage kiting.
scenes.transition_out_text: He steps over the remains of the elite, his heart pounding with adrenaline.

sections.title: Deep Catacombs
sections.intent: Escalate the difficulty and show Artie pushing his agility to the limit.
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the central vault containing the legendary loot.

scenes.summary: Artie navigates a room filled with pressure-plate traps.
scenes.outcome: Artie uses his speed to trigger and outrun the traps simultaneously.
scenes.transition_in_text: The corridor floor is tiled with suspicious-looking stone plates.
scenes.transition_out_text: He dances across the plates, arrows whistling through the air behind him.

scenes.summary: Artie encounters a ghost-type mob that ignores physical obstacles.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he must use environmental traps to damage the ghost.
scenes.transition_in_text: A translucent form drifts through the wall, its eyes glowing cold blue.
scenes.transition_out_text: The ghost shrieks as it is caught in the path of a swinging blade trap.

scenes.summary: Artie finds a temporary buff shrine that increases his speed further.
scenes.outcome: The buff allows Artie to move so fast that the game's physics begin to jitter.
scenes.transition_in_text: A pedestal in the center of the room glows with a golden light.
scenes.transition_out_text: He touches the shrine, and the world seems to slow down around him.

scenes.summary: Artie reaches the entrance to the central vault.
scenes.outcome: Artie unlocks the vault door using a series of high-speed inputs.
scenes.transition_in_text: The vault door is covered in complex, moving runic symbols.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie reaches the central vault containing the legendary loot.
scenes.transition_out_text: The massive gears of the vault door begin to turn with a thunderous roar.

sections.title: The Unseen Heist
sections.intent: Artie claims the prize and triggers the guild-wide alert.
sections.end_condition: Artie loots the Key of the Unseen and realizes he is being tracked by players.

scenes.summary: Artie finds the 'Speedster's Cloak' and the 'Key of the Unseen' on a pedestal.
scenes.outcome: Artie equips the cloak, significantly boosting his Agility.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie approaches the treasure, his eyes fixed on the shimmering fabric.
scenes.transition_out_text: He drapes the cloak over his shoulders, feeling a surge of power.

scenes.summary: Artie picks up the Key of the Unseen, triggering a dungeon-wide alarm.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes the key is a unique item that broadcasts his location to the server.
scenes.transition_in_text: As his fingers close around the golden key, a siren wails throughout the dungeon.
scenes.transition_out_text: A system notification flashes red: 'WORLD ITEM CLAIMED. TRACKING ACTIVE.'

scenes.summary: Artie sees a group of players entering the dungeon on his mini-map.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he is being hunted by a player-run guild.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie checks his HUD, seeing several blue dots moving toward his position.
scenes.transition_out_text: He turns toward the back exit of the vault, his heart racing.

scenes.summary: Artie escapes the vault and heads for the surface.
scenes.outcome: Artie makes it to the surface but finds the exit surrounded.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie sprints through the winding tunnels, the sound of player voices echoing behind him.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie loots the Key of the Unseen and realizes he is being tracked by players.
scenes.transition_out_text: He reaches the final set of stairs, the light of the surface visible above.

chapters.stakes_shift: The threat shifts from monster-slaying to surviving a direct System intervention.

sections.title: The Manual Audit
sections.intent: Introduce the Player Moderator as a direct antagonist.
sections.end_condition: The Moderator corners Artie at the dungeon exit.

scenes.summary: Artie exits the dungeon and finds a figure in white robes waiting for him.
scenes.outcome: The Moderator introduces himself and demands Artie submit to an audit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps out into the cool night air, but stops dead at the sight of the figure.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Moderator raises a glowing staff, his voice echoing with authority.

scenes.summary: Artie tries to bluff his way out of the audit.
scenes.outcome: The Moderator sees through the bluff and attempts to freeze Artie's character.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie tries to force a laugh, but his voice cracks.
scenes.transition_out_text: A wave of blue energy pulses from the Moderator's staff.

scenes.summary: Artie uses his Agility to dodge the freeze spell and begins to run.
scenes.outcome: The Moderator realizes Artie's stats are indeed glitched and begins a pursuit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's instincts kick in, and he rolls to the side just as the energy hits the ground.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The Moderator corners Artie at the dungeon exit.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie bolts into the woods, the Moderator's robes fluttering as he follows.

sections.title: The High-Speed Chase
sections.intent: A frantic escape across the map using every movement exploit Artie knows.
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the physical boundary of the stable game world.

scenes.summary: Artie uses the trees to gain verticality and speed.
scenes.outcome: Artie manages to put some distance between himself and the Moderator.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie springs from a low branch, his movements fluid and frantic.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks back to see the Moderator flying just above the treeline.

scenes.summary: The Moderator uses system commands to alter the terrain in front of Artie.
scenes.outcome: Artie is forced to use his 'Hit & Run' dodge to bypass a spawned wall.
scenes.transition_in_text: The ground ahead of Artie erupts into a wall of jagged stone.
scenes.transition_out_text: He slides under a closing gap, the stone scraping his cloak.

scenes.summary: Artie reaches a river and uses his speed to run across the surface of the water.
scenes.outcome: The Moderator is momentarily delayed as he must fly over the water.
scenes.transition_in_text: The sound of rushing water fills the air as Artie approaches the riverbank.
scenes.transition_out_text: His feet kick up spray as he sprints across the surface like a skipping stone.

scenes.summary: Artie reaches the edge of the map, where the textures begin to blur.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he is at the edge of the stable world.
scenes.transition_in_text: The trees ahead become blocky and low-resolution.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie reaches the physical boundary of the stable game world.
scenes.transition_out_text: He stops at the edge of a shimmering, pixelated curtain.

sections.title: Crossing the Threshold
sections.intent: Artie makes the desperate choice to enter the Dead-Zone.
sections.end_condition: Artie vanishes into the Dead-Zone static, evading the Moderator's grasp.

scenes.summary: The Moderator catches up and tries to convince Artie to surrender.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes the Moderator is afraid to enter the Dead-Zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Moderator descends, his robes glowing with a warning aura.
scenes.transition_out_text: He gestures toward the pixelated curtain with a look of genuine concern.

scenes.summary: Artie takes a leap of faith into the static.
scenes.outcome: Artie enters the Dead-Zone, and his HUD begins to glitch out.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie takes a deep breath and dives headfirst into the shimmering wall.
scenes.transition_out_text: The world explodes into a cacophony of white noise and static.

scenes.summary: Artie disappears from the Moderator's scanners.
scenes.outcome: Artie is safe for now, but he is trapped in an unstable environment.
scenes.transition_in_text: The static settles, leaving Artie in a landscape of floating geometry.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie vanishes into the Dead-Zone static, evading the Moderator's grasp.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks at his hands, which are flickering like a bad video signal.

sections.end_condition: Artie and Bulwark agree to a temporary truce to survive the zone.

scenes.summary: Artie wanders the Dead-Zone and finds a massive tank player fighting glitched mobs.
scenes.outcome: Artie meets Bulwark, who is stuck in the zone due to a different glitch.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie hears the sound of metal clashing against stone in the distance.
scenes.transition_out_text: A man in heavy iron plate armor turns to face him, his shield raised.

scenes.summary: Bulwark explains his situation: he has infinite HP but zero damage output.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes they are perfect opposites.
scenes.transition_in_text: Bulwark lowers his shield, his shoulders slumping with exhaustion.
scenes.transition_out_text: He points to his character sheet, showing a health bar that stretches off the screen.

scenes.summary: Artie and Bulwark discuss the possibility of working together.
scenes.outcome: They form a party, combining their glitched stats.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie offers a hand, though he's careful not to touch the tank too hard.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie and Bulwark agree to a temporary truce to survive the zone.
scenes.transition_out_text: A party notification appears: 'ARTIE HAS JOINED BULWARK'S PARTY.'

sections.title: Turbo-Tanking
sections.intent: The duo learns to combine their opposite builds (Max HP vs Max AGI).
sections.end_condition: The party successfully clears a glitched mob pack using their new synergy.

scenes.summary: The pair encounters a pack of 'Lag-Dogs' that move in stuttering bursts.
scenes.outcome: Bulwark takes the aggro while Artie positions himself for a crit.
scenes.transition_in_text: The shadows around them begin to flicker and bark in a digital rasp.
scenes.transition_out_text: Bulwark slams his shield into the ground, a golden aura erupting from the impact.

scenes.summary: Artie struggles to time his attacks with Bulwark's movements.
scenes.outcome: They realize they need to synchronize their actions to maximize the 'Hit & Run' bonus.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie lunges, but the dog glitches five feet to the left at the last second.
scenes.transition_out_text: He nearly falls, his heart skipping a beat as he narrowly avoids a counter-attack.

scenes.summary: Bulwark uses a 'Taunt' skill that also slows the enemies down.
scenes.outcome: Artie finds the perfect opening and wipes the pack in a single flurry.
scenes.transition_in_text: Bulwark bellows a challenge, his voice echoing through the ruins.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie becomes a blur of steel, the dogs dissolving into pixels.

scenes.summary: The duo celebrates their first successful combat encounter.
scenes.outcome: They gain a level and realize their synergy is incredibly powerful.
scenes.transition_in_text: The golden glow of a level-up washes over both of them.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The party successfully clears a glitched mob pack using their new synergy.
scenes.transition_out_text: Bulwark offers a heavy-handed pat on the back, which Artie narrowly dodges.

sections.title: The Gate of Glitches
sections.intent: The pair reaches the final obstacle preventing their escape.
sections.end_condition: They arrive at the Dead-Zone Gate and trigger the Guardian's spawn.

scenes.summary: Artie and Bulwark travel toward the center of the Dead-Zone.
scenes.outcome: They encounter more environmental hazards that require both of their skills to bypass.
scenes.transition_in_text: The landscape becomes more surreal as they move deeper into the zone.
scenes.transition_out_text: They navigate a bridge of floating tiles that disappear and reappear.

scenes.summary: They find the massive gate that leads back to the stable world.
scenes.outcome: Artie uses the Key of the Unseen to activate the gate.
scenes.transition_in_text: A towering structure of black stone and white static looms ahead.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie inserts the golden key into a slot that shouldn't exist.

scenes.summary: The gate activates, but instead of opening, it spawns a massive Guardian.
scenes.outcome: The Dead-Zone Guardian emerges, and the final battle begins.
scenes.transition_in_text: The ground shakes as a massive form begins to pull itself out of the static.
scenes.end_condition_echo: They arrive at the Dead-Zone Gate and trigger the Guardian's spawn.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Guardian roars, a sound like a thousand corrupted audio files.

chapters.title: Critical Failure
chapters.goal: Defeat the regional Dead-Zone Guardian by 'overclocking' the environment's physics.
chapters.stakes_shift: The survival of the party and the potential to ascend to a new tier of 'System-Breaker'.

bridge.from_prev: The Guardian blocks the only exit back to the stable world.
bridge.to_next: The Guardian's defeat shatters the zone boundaries, causing a massive server-wide event.

sections.title: The Physics Wall
sections.intent: The Guardian proves immune to standard damage, forcing a new strategy.
sections.end_condition: Artie identifies a way to weaponize the zone's lag and physics bugs.

scenes.summary: Artie and Bulwark engage the Guardian.
scenes.outcome: They realize the Guardian has an infinite health pool that resets every few seconds.
scenes.transition_in_text: Bulwark charges the Guardian, his shield glowing with defensive energy.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's strike lands, but the damage numbers simply disappear.

scenes.summary: The Guardian uses a 'Server Lag' attack that slows the party down.
scenes.outcome: Artie uses his speed to move between the lag frames.
scenes.transition_in_text: The world begins to stutter, frames dropping as the Guardian raises its hand.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie finds he can move in the gaps between the stutters.

scenes.summary: Artie observes the Guardian's connection to the environment.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes the Guardian is powered by the zone's instability.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie watches the way the static flows into the Guardian's chest.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks at Bulwark, a new plan forming in his mind.

scenes.summary: Artie explains the plan to Bulwark: they need to overload the zone's physics.
scenes.outcome: Bulwark agrees to act as a physical anchor for the overload.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie shouts the plan over the roar of the Guardian.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie identifies a way to weaponize the zone's lag and physics bugs.
scenes.transition_out_text: Bulwark nods, planting his feet and bracing his shield.

sections.title: Overclocking the Server
sections.intent: Artie pushes his speed to a level that begins to break the local reality.
sections.end_condition: The environment fragments as Artie achieves a 'Critical Velocity' state.

scenes.summary: Artie begins to run in a massive circle around the Guardian.
scenes.outcome: The speed creates a vortex of static that begins to pull in the environment.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's feet become a blur as he accelerates beyond his normal limits.
scenes.transition_out_text: A funnel of white noise begins to form around the arena.

scenes.summary: The Guardian tries to swat Artie out of the air, but he is too fast.
scenes.outcome: The Guardian's own attacks begin to hit the vortex, increasing its instability.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Guardian's massive fist slams into the ground where Artie was a microsecond before.
scenes.transition_out_text: Each missed strike adds more energy to the swirling storm.

scenes.summary: Bulwark uses his infinite HP to withstand the environmental damage from the vortex.
scenes.outcome: Bulwark provides a stable point for Artie to pivot off of.
scenes.transition_in_text: Debris from the ruins pelt Bulwark's armor, but he doesn't flinch.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie uses Bulwark's shield as a ramp, launching himself into the air.

scenes.summary: Artie reaches a speed that the system cannot track.
scenes.outcome: The world around Artie turns into a smear of colors.
scenes.transition_in_text: The wind howls in Artie's ears as the landscape dissolves into lines of light.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The environment fragments as Artie achieves a 'Critical Velocity' state.
scenes.transition_out_text: A system error message fills his vision: 'VELOCITY ERROR. PHYSICS ENGINE FAILURE.'

sections.title: System Crash
sections.intent: The final blow that shatters the Guardian and the zone itself.
sections.end_condition: The Guardian is deleted and the resulting explosion shatters the zone boundaries.

scenes.summary: Artie delivers the final critical hit at max velocity.
scenes.outcome: The Guardian's health bar glitches and shows a negative value.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie strikes the Guardian's core with the force of a falling star.
scenes.transition_out_text: The damage number overflows, turning into a string of nonsensical symbols.

scenes.summary: The Guardian begins to implode, pulling the Dead-Zone with it.
scenes.outcome: The gate begins to crack under the pressure.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Guardian's body collapses inward, a black hole of data forming at its center.
scenes.transition_out_text: Cracks of white light spread across the surface of the gate.

scenes.summary: Artie and Bulwark are thrown through the gate by the explosion.
scenes.outcome: They are ejected from the Dead-Zone as it collapses.
scenes.transition_in_text: The world white-outs as the server finally gives up on calculating the physics.
scenes.transition_out_text: They tumble through a tunnel of light, the sound of the crash fading.

scenes.summary: The Dead-Zone is deleted, and the party lands in the capital city outskirts.
scenes.outcome: The explosion wipes their local history, effectively clearing their immediate bounty.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie hits the ground hard, the smell of burnt ozone filling his nostrils.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The Guardian is deleted and the resulting explosion shatters the zone boundaries.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks up to see the spires of the capital city gleaming in the distance.

chapters.title: Hit, Run, Repeat
chapters.goal: Secure a new identity in the capital city while the System logs are purged by the explosion.
chapters.stakes_shift: Transitioning from a local nuisance to a legendary figure in the game's underground.

bridge.from_prev: Emerging from the Dead-Zone with massive XP and a purged bounty.
bridge.to_next: The next expansion opens, and Artie realizes his 'Crit' key is the only way in.

sections.title: The Capital Infiltration
sections.intent: Artie and Bulwark use the server chaos to slip into the capital.
sections.end_condition: The duo secures a hidden base within the city's underground.

scenes.summary: Artie and Bulwark enter the capital city during the confusion of the server reboot.
scenes.outcome: They blend in with the crowd of returning players.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie pulls his hood up, walking alongside Bulwark through the massive gates.
scenes.transition_out_text: The guards are too busy dealing with the influx of lag-reports to notice them.

scenes.summary: They find an abandoned warehouse in the sewers.
scenes.outcome: They establish a temporary base of operations.
scenes.transition_in_text: They descend a ladder into the cool, damp tunnels beneath the streets.
scenes.transition_out_text: Bulwark kicks open the door to a dusty, forgotten storage room.

scenes.summary: Artie sets up a monitoring station using his glitched UI.
scenes.outcome: Artie can now track the Moderator's movements.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie waves his hand, several translucent screens appearing in the air.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The duo secures a hidden base within the city's underground.
scenes.transition_out_text: He settles into a chair, his eyes reflecting the blue light of the data.

sections.title: The Log Purge
sections.intent: Artie uses his glitched status to access the server's backend logs.
sections.end_condition: Artie successfully wipes his Red Name status and bounty.

scenes.summary: Artie infiltrates the local 'Hall of Records' to access the server node.
scenes.outcome: Artie finds the physical manifestation of his character's log files.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie slips through the ventilation ducts of the record hall.
scenes.transition_out_text: He drops into a room filled with glowing crystals, each containing data.

scenes.summary: Artie uses the Key of the Unseen to bypass the node's security.
scenes.outcome: Artie gains administrative access to his own character file.
scenes.transition_in_text: He holds the golden key against the central crystal, which pulses in response.
scenes.transition_out_text: The red glow of his nameplate begins to fade into a neutral white.

scenes.summary: Artie deletes the records of his tutorial boss kill.
scenes.outcome: Artie is no longer an 'Anomaly' in the system's eyes.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's fingers fly across the virtual keyboard, deleting lines of code.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie successfully wipes his Red Name status and bounty.
scenes.transition_out_text: He exhales a long breath, the weight of the bounty finally lifted.

sections.title: The Expansion Key
sections.intent: Set up the next book by revealing the true purpose of the Key of the Unseen.
sections.end_condition: Artie unlocks the gate to the new expansion, cementing his role as a System-Breaker.

scenes.summary: Artie returns to the base and discovers a new quest notification.
scenes.outcome: The Key of the Unseen is revealed to be the only way to enter the 'Unpatched Lands'.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie walks back into the warehouse, the key glowing brighter than ever.
scenes.transition_out_text: A new window pops up: 'QUEST START: THE UNPATCHED LANDS.'

scenes.summary: Artie and Bulwark prepare to head toward the expansion gate.
scenes.outcome: They realize they are the only ones who can access the new content.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie inserts the Key of the Unseen into the shimmering rift.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie unlocks the gate to the new expansion, cementing his role as a System-Breaker.
scenes.transition_out_text: He looks back at Bulwark and grins. 'Ready to break some more rules?'
